verdict.rationale: Honeycomb docs confirm traces, logs, and metrics can all be ingested via OpenTelemetry into a unified event model, and query builder supports relational span fields (root/parent/child) enabling trace-based investigation, which implies some cross-signal correlation. However, no evidence documents a specific UI feature for jumping directly from a trace span to correlated logs/metrics, and a community report explicitly describes using separate tools (Honeycomb for traces, OpenSearch for logs, VictoriaMetrics for metrics) during incidents, suggesting the unified 'trace-to-logs-to-metrics' navigation isn't a seamless built-in workflow in practice. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a UI mechanism (e.g., 'view logs for this span' button) and independent confirmation that correlation-based navigation works end-to-end.
